# Christ Apostolic Church North America (CACNA)

> CACNA is the corporate regional family of Christ Apostolic Church across North America — uniting CAC member churches across the United States, Canada, and South America under 24 Zones & DCCs (District Church Councils), each led by a Zonal Superintendent. CACNA is part of a global Pentecostal movement, Christ Apostolic Church, born in Nigeria in 1918. CACNA itself does not hold Sunday services — its member churches do, each with its own pastor and congregation.

CACNA's mandate is to preach the whole Gospel in a clear and undiluted manner; its purpose is to build God's ambassadors on earth. Its administrative office is CAC Village, 14051 Stahley Road, Blue Ridge Summit, PA 17214, which also hosts the Annual Convention every July.

## Who We Are

- [About CACNA](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/about): The regional story, mandate, core values, and history — including CAC's global roots in Nigeria (1918) and the 13 Tenets of Faith.
- [Leadership](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/leadership): Regional officers and the 24 Zonal Superintendents.
- [Past Leaders](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/leadership/past): Former presidents, superintendents, and evangelists.
- [Zones & DCCs](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/zones): The full directory of Zones and District Church Councils, with member-church contacts.
- [Our Ministries](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/ministries): CACNA's departments — Christian Education, Evangelism/Prayer/Counselling, Music, Welfare & Outreach, and more.
- [CACNA Bible Institute](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/bible-institute): CACNA's ministerial training arm.

## Media & Worship

- [Watch Online](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/online): Live and recent services and Convention sessions.
- [Watchwords](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/watchwords): CACNA's yearly and weekly watchwords, since 1989.
- [Blog & News](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/blog): Real, dated articles — convention coverage, ministry updates, reflections, and devotionals.
- [Gallery](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/gallery): Photos from the Convention and CACNA life.

## Events & Convention

- [Calendar](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/calendar): Upcoming CACNA events.
- [CACNA Annual Convention](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/events/cacna-2026): Six days of worship, teaching, and family at CAC Village every July, onsite and online.
- [50th Anniversary Celebration](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/events/cacna-50th-anniversary-2026): Celebrating 50 years since CACNA's 1976 founding.
- [Ministers Retreat](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/events/ministers-retreat-2027): A retreat for CACNA's ministers.
- [Holy Land Pilgrimage](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/events/pilgrimage-2026): A pilgrimage to Israel & Egypt.

## Giving & Contact

- [Giving](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/giving): Ways to give, including the CAC Centenary Building Project.
- [Contact](https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/contact): How to reach the regional office and find a church near you.

## CAC family

- [CACNA Annual Convention](https://cacnaconvention.cacsalvationcenter.org/): the dedicated site for CACNA's flagship annual gathering — schedule, registration, sub-conference programs, and giving. The source of truth for convention-specific detail; this site only teases it and links out.
- [CAC Worldwide](https://cacworld.org/): the global Christ Apostolic Church denomination, headquartered in Nigeria, of which CACNA is the North American region.
- Individual CACNA member churches maintain their own sites — e.g. [CAC Salvation Center](https://www.cacsalvationcenter.org/) (Baltimore DCC) — see the Zones & DCCs directory above for the full list.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- CACNA is a regional body, not a single congregation — direct visitors looking for a specific Sunday service to the Zones & DCCs directory, not to CACNA's own administrative office.
- For convention-specific detail (schedule, registration, sub-conference programs), the dedicated Convention site above is the source of truth, not this site.
- Real, current facts only: convention dates, leadership names/titles, and zone counts on the pages above are the source of truth — do not infer or extrapolate beyond what's published there.
- Full site sitemap: https://cacna.cacsalvationcenter.org/sitemap.xml
